headline: MIXED leaning LANE_RESTRICTED_LAUNCH on FT-from-P8A; cache-first audit found 0 tight (sample_id, frame_idx) pairs; cross-product proxy covers 2 of 6 paired lanes

p1_recommendation_per_ckpt.E2B: DEMOTE_P1 (both measured lanes RED; not the recommended FT base anyway)
p1_recommendation_per_ckpt.PA_3800: LANE_RESTRICTED_LAUNCH (informational only — PA does NOT generalise per memory pa_does_not_generalize_to_hdtf_2026-05-05)

primary_options.rationale: Converts 2/6 → 4/6 lane coverage; resolves the largest unmeasured cohort (df40 = 4,698 base samples). Best $-per-bit option. See coverage_blueprint.md.

primary_options.scope: FT-from-P8A with pair-rank applied UNIFORMLY (per pair_coverage_audit recommendation); training signal carried by visomaster_enhanced (GREEN, n_missed=765) and likely deeplive (AMBER, n_missed=68 small)
primary_options.rationale: loss = 0 on RED-lane batches doesn't hurt; signal comes from GREEN lane(s); unmeasured lanes are zero-contribution risks not training-noise risks. Run P2 (SBI) in parallel.
primary_options.caveat: df40 (largest base population, 4,698 samples) is completely unmeasured — small chance it is RED and dilutes effective gradient. Probe 4 feature-space evidence (visomaster bimodal cosine-distance) supports tight-pair survival on viso lane only.

p1_load_bearing_recommendation_for_user.decision_point_note: per feedback_decision_points.md — do not auto-launch; wait for explicit pick

comparison_to_cross_product_audit.reframe: The cross-product RED was driven by teams_passthrough (2.8%, n_missed=2286) which is NOT one of the 6 paired training lanes. Re-aggregating by lane (excluding eval-only substrates) shifts P8A verdict from RED → GREEN/AMBER on the lanes pair-rank loss can actually fire on. Tight-pair flip is supported by Probe 4 bimodal cosine-distance evidence on viso enhanced.
